code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (pH 6.8, low O2 saturation/PaO2), pancytopenia (anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia), and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH, D-dimer). There is also mild hyperchloremia and coagulopathy (INR 1.4). Findings suggest severe systemic illness, likely with hypoxic respiratory failure and possible sepsis or multi-organ dysfunction. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are warranted.
